newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Banco Itau denies interest in Bamerindus - report.
newsitem.headline: Banco Itau denies interest in Bamerindus - report.

text.p: Private Brazilian bank Banco Itau denied talks or any interest in acquiring bank Bamerindus, private Invest News agency reported.
Roberto Egydio Setubal, Itau's president, told the agency the bank has a $180 million investment plan for 1996 but it does not include the opening of new branches or the acquisition of a bank.

Setubal made these comments at a meeting with market analysts to present Itau's first half balance sheet. Early this month, the bank announced a 277 million real net profit for the January-to-June period.
